notes.title: Quick Patch Notes 0.3.4.11
notes.notes:
Heey, driftheads!

A little breakout forced us to make a series of patches in the last days. Nothing major except for gradual improvement of integrity. We advise you not to use any kind of third-party files to mod core gameplay, this could potentially corrupt player data.

Anyway, we're getting ready post on new scoring system with some fancy images and such. 

Stay tuned, we're almost on the home straight now.

Cheers!

notes.title: About the global update
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello, Driftheads![/h1]

[b]It's been a while.[/b] Yup, we're working full-time to take High Octane Drift to a whole new standards. Written from a scratch more realistic physics, more details on tracks, better effects and more gameplay. [img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26495689/c3280e80d17f1b05e403e724bdedaf727366f75b.jpg[/img]
In the course of getting it all together, we will publish more news updates on new aspects. You probably heard it before, but we didn't have special guys to take this over. Now we do. Meet [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/hodcom]Apro[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/k4waii]CFW[/url]. These will take care on community activities and russian propoganda.

We're moving towards more skilled and rewarding drifting within Drifting series. One of our official in-house series will be United Drift Championship (UDC). Drifting series will be covered in details in later posts.

[b]In the meantime,[/b] we are finishing tracks for UDC. [i]Accidentally[/i], they are the same as Formula Drift 2018 Pro Championship tracks with the same layouts. Long Beach, Orlando, Atlanta, NJ, Monroe, St.Louis, Texas and Final Round track. Speaking of which. Previous finals were held in legendary Irwindale. This year's final will take place in Las Vegas, due to Irwindale management announcement about seizing its operations. Somewhere by the end of 2017, they've made another breaking news - money were found and they will be kicking for at least next five years. [b]So[/b], where should we take our players for final round of UDC 2018 seasons: [b]Las Vegas or Irwindale?[/b] [u]Write your opinion in comments![/u]

Anyway, as we're getting where we wanted, we've planned some posts to cover new major things. Keep it up!

[h1]Current status[/h1]
[b]Internal testing intensifies.[/b]
We're actively testing, fixing and optimizing everything that we've found. Next phase will be closed testing and then open testing.

[h1]Community activity[/h1]
[list]
[*]First of all: Thanks to all those who believe in us, helps and makes this game better and more interesting. You are best! [i](haters too:D)[/i]
[*]Community manager [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/k4waii]CFW[/url] was launched Discord-server, welcome: [url=https://discord.gg/T27Dc4R]HOD Legacy[/url]!!!
[*]On the [url=https://discord.gg/T27Dc4R]Discord-server[/url] there are:
[list]
[*]Rules
[*]Moderators
[*]Support
[*]Game news
[*]Many sorted chats
[*]Good atmosphere
[*]Good cars settings
[/list]
[*]Also subscribe to our [i]Instagram[/i] [url=https://www.instagram.com/highoctanedrift.official/]@highoctanedrift.official[/url]
[*]The news will be published more often. Now [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/hodcom]Apro[/url] is responsible for them.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Release Notes
notes.notes:
Hey, driftheads! What up?)

It's been a long way to Steam release, but here it is. Early Access version b0.2.3. Only US server, as we've mentioned before. But EU server is coming right away.

We are expecting minor bugs, which could be annoying but shouldn't be critical. Please, report them through Steam Discussion or on our forum @ cruderocks.com

UPD: people already reporting keyboard not interacting >_<.  If you are using any kind of antiviral with sandbox mode, try shut it down for a while. We will investigate into it ASAP.

Some things might be a bit frustrating without proper helping tips, we're working on it. If that's the case don't hesitate to ask. There is a community of players migrating from different social networks, who can actually help with an advice.

Account transfer from Facebook to Steam will be covered in a different announcement.

Content is a bit rough in some places because we drag it since web-client prototype, but we're already putting effort to replace it and polish some new before going public.

Supposedly, next week we're going to open Workshop where you can upload custom car models straight to the game and send it to a curated High Octane Drift Steam Workshop. In case your model will actually make to the game, you will be paid royalties by Steam. We are pretty excited what opportunities it will bring. but more on that later.

Drift On!
